Automated translation (refer to source for accuracy)

Starting November 20, 2025 (Reiwa 7), Saitama Prefecture is accepting applications for naming rights partners for three dams it manages. These popular tourist destinations are looking for a sponsor to put their name on these attractive facilities.

For full details on the recruitment, see the flyer.

〈Key details〉

Facilities: Gassho Dam, Arima Dam, Gongen-do Adjustment Pond

Application deadline: January 21, 2026 (Reiwa 8) (Wednesday)

※Email and required documents must arrive by the deadline

Inquiries:
Saitama Prefecture Department of Land Development, River Environment Division, Dam Management Section
Tel: 048-830-5116
Email: a5110-03@pref.saitama.lg.jp

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-cci.or.jp/xo_event/xo_event-2348/
